item.title: Trump Slams 'Terrible' Supreme Court Decision, Tips 'Potentially Higher' Tariffs
item.description: Trump says he'll impose a 10% tariff on all countries using a little-known authority after the Supreme Court invalidates the 'reciprocal' tariffs he announced last year.

item.description: No matter what your plans are for this weekend, set a few minutes aside to check out these deals for as much as 48% off top tech from Acer, HP, Samsung and other top brands.

item.title: Tesla's New FSD Terms Say It Can Change the Price and Features at Any Time
item.description: After cutting its one-time, lifetime access fee, the company updates its Full Self-Driving terms to say it can now change what you're paying and how much you get whenever it wants.

item.title: $20 for a Pokémon ROM? Not If You Have a Mac and Some Time on Your Hands
item.description: The Pokémon Company wants you to spend $20 on its 20-year-old Game Boy Advance games. If you have a Mac, OpenEmu is the perfect alternative.

item.title: Unpacking Starliner Failures, NASA Chief Delivers Scathing Assessment
item.description: 'NASA will not fly another crew on [Boeing's] Starliner until technical causes are understood and corrected,' says NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman.

item.title: Colorado Lawmakers Push for Age Verification at the Operating System Level
item.description: Rather than having people verify their age on every app they use, Colorado's SB26-051 would implement a way for devices to share an 'age-bracket' signal to third-party apps.

item.title: Rate the Income Tax Apps and Services You're Filing With This Year
item.description: Like it or not, it's tax season again. Which app or service do you use to prepare your returns? Complete the survey, then enter to win $250.

item.title: Amazon: Recent Service Disruptions 'Not Linked' to AI Agents
item.description: Amazon traced a December disruption to engineers using its Kiro AI coding tool, but says the problem 'stemmed from a misconfigured role,' and was not a case of AI going rogue.
